build_cost_scope: shared registry and toolchain caches; no fully cold host build claim
raw_schema_note: queries.csv retains every per-query observation; plans.json retains selected plans and sampling decisions; process CPU includes setup and opens, not per-query CPU
limitations: Dataset fits RAM; not larger-than-memory qualification.
OS page cache and other workstation activity are uncontrolled.
Same source/binary with configuration off/on; no separately compiled pristine-main baseline.
Two process orders per scenario; no confidence intervals or universal performance guarantee.
